body:
Slice 9 of #899.

**Changes:** `crates/core` holds `settings`, `agents`, `hooks`, `skills`, `forwarder`, `webhook`, `local_paths`, `review_bot`, `coderabbit`, `codex`, `cubic`, `lease`, `board`, `state`, `work_item`, `pacer`, `usage`, `forge_ledger`, `totp`, `profile`, `ports` and `paths`, on top of the base crate. **Removes:** no link by itself. From here the build stops these modules from reaching the guard, the adapters, the runner, the dog or the binary.

Touches: `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `crates/core/Cargo.toml` (new), `crates/core/src/lib.rs` (new), the 22 modules' files and folders, moved from `src/` to `crates/core/src/`, `src/lib.rs`, `src/test.rs` and the `src/test/` stand-ins for the core's ports, `src/parity.rs` where it reads moved files, `.github/workflows/test.yml`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CODING_STANDARDS.md`, `docs/design/` and `docs/agents/sandbox-red-tests.md` where they name moved paths

## What to build

Why: these modules use each other in loops (`src/agents.rs:23`, `src/review_bot.rs:15-17`, `src/state.rs:37-40`), so they move together. #901, #903, #904 and #905 removed the links they had up.

- Before moving: `grep -rnE 'crate::(guard|confine|bridge|browse|adapters|github|runner|issues|transcripts|dog|sheep|flock|doctor|upgrade|schema)\b'` over the 22 modules' files prints nothing, intra-doc links included. The request's order put `profile`, `usage`, `codex`, `cubic`, `work_item`, `agents`, `board` and `totp` above modules this crate leaves out, so a link from them would not have been counted. A value or constant found moves down with this slice. Anything else stops the slice, and the builder says on this issue what was found before going on.
- `crates/core` is set up as #907 set up the base crate: the package name from #899's Q1, `publish = false`, the workspace's fields and lints, the base crate as its one member dependency, and a `test-support` feature.
- Each moved module keeps its name. `crates/core/src/lib.rs` brings the base crate's modules in with private `use` lines at its root, so their `crate::home` paths inside the core keep working.
- `src/lib.rs` re-exports each moved module under its old name.
- Visibility, `test-support`, tests that need something higher and embedded files work as in #907. The `src/test/` stand-ins that implement a `ports` trait (the forge, git, the agents, the reviewer, the meter and the rest) move into the core crate behind `test-support`. The agent defaults, the vendored skills, `profile`'s `worker-instructions.md` and `settings.example.toml` stay reachable at the same files.
- Unchanged: the code, apart from visibility and paths, and every test's name and assertions.

Blocked by #907 (the workspace), and by #901, #903, #904 and #905, which take the core's last links up out of `board`, `ports` and `settings`.

Collides with open work on these modules: #888 and #630 are in progress, and #889 to #895, #632 to #635, #757 and #784 are ready. #899's Q4 asks when to take it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cargo test --locked -- --list` names the same tests, by full path, before and after, and the pull request's body gives both counts
- [ ] `crates/core/Cargo.toml` depends on the base crate and no other member
- [ ] The tests in `parity` pass and find the same providers and branches as before
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --lib settings`, `cargo test --lib state`, `cargo test --lib ports`, `cargo test --lib board`, `cargo test --lib lease` and `cargo test --lib parity`. The tests listed in `docs/agents/sandbox-red-tests.md`, the whole suite, rustdoc and the MSRV check are left to CI
- [ ] `scripts/file-size.sh`, `scripts/docs-links.py` and `scripts/design-size.sh` pass
title: crates/core holds the vocabulary and the ports: settings, agents, hooks, skills, review bots, leases, board, state, work items and ports
